rows.en: Right. All we can do is believe in it and push on.
So the monsters have been revived again...
Yeah. And they're some pretty tough opponents, too.
It may be a hard fight, but if you win, you should be able to reach Belial.
Of course. This time, I'll smash Belial for good!
So you've defeated King Pandon.
That leaves "Zetton" and "Tyrant"... Don't let your guard down.
So you've defeated Zetton.
Only "Tyrant" is left. You're almost at Belial.
You've defeated all the revived monsters! It seems Belial is in the plaza.
This may be the final battle. Make sure you're fully prepared before you go.
You've finally cornered Belial. This may be the final battle.
He intends to destroy the world. We must stop him, no matter what.
Defeat Belial and put a stop to it!!
If "Regis" achieves its ambitions, a world at peace will never come again.
We are those who love peace. And we are heroes.
We must stop this crisis before it engulfs the world.
Most likely, the battle with "Regis" will truly be the final battle.
There's no one here.
They showed me around the base, but to me, it's all things from another world.
Still, why would a place like this exist so close to an enemy Cube...?
I hear you fell into an enemy trap? No, I don't think you were being careless.
The enemy's methods are getting more cunning. You'd better be even more on guard than before.
I heard the Ultra Cube is frozen.
I was just discussing the cause with Hikari.
The Devil Gundam...? And a Gundam searching for it...?
Veda might be able to tell us something, but in this world, even that's impossible...
DG Cells... The metal cells that make up the Devil Gundam...
Enemies infected with those cells have come back to life. And stronger, at that...
I don't know the details, but the original Devil Gundam seems quite formidable.
Gundam Heaven's Sword...? So a new Gundam turns up at this stage.
No, I don't accept it. A thing like that can't possibly be a Gundam...!!
So the path has been blocked... In that case, all you can do is take another route.
A passage guarded by electric shocks... There should be some item that works against it...
So the enemy is getting a grip on Core Medal technology, too...
What are you doing? Hurry and go rescue the Ultra Brothers.
That's the way. I'm counting on you to rescue the other Ultra Brothers, too.
That's the way. I'm counting on you to rescue the other Ultra Brothers, too.
Zoffy is the Captain of the Space Garrison. For someone like him to agree to be our commander...
Dummy
This place is really relaxing, y'know?
The Quest Room, huh... It's relaxing here.
We've got coffee and stuff, too, so help yourself.
What? Coffee? I'll have you know, I'm very particular about my coffee.
Fine. I'll give it a taste...
...Awful. This is enough to make good beans weep...
You show up out of nowhere and that's what you say? Harsh.
Make sure you check the quest requests regularly, okay?
Huh? Believe it or not, I'm on the job right now.
A Ride Machine...? Doesn't look like it can stand in for the DenLiner.
Hey, what does it look like? I can't wait!
What I'm interested in is how "strong" this thing is.
Looks like the Ride Machine's finished.
For now, anyway.
For now?
The Ride Machine was built by applying technology from all sorts of worlds.
It's designed to take in any unknown technologies we're likely to acquire down the line, too.
Isn't that amazing? So you can keep on upgrading it?
Exactly. It gives me chills!
You found Kamen Rider Black RX? Amazing!
Black RX... His strength'll make ya cry.
But when it comes to lookin' cool, he's got nothin' on My Special Attack, Part 2.
He's way, way senior to us, you know?
Shut up!! If he upstages me, he's gonna pay!!
So you're finally going up against The O?
Yeah! It's finally the climax. Well, I'm always at my climax, though.
ZZZZ...
Hey! Bear! Is this any time to be sleepin'!?
It's no use, Sempai. Nothing's gonna wake Kin-chan up, y'know?
{8074}, I hear a new Cube has been found?
ZZZ... ZZZ... ZZZZZZ!!
They say it's called the "Hideout Cube"?
Hey, hey, Accel, why are you carrying a tire on your back? Isn't it heavy?
And that research there is more advanced than in the "Begins Cube"...
ZZZZ---ZZ... ZZZZ!!
...or so I heard, but...
Whoa!! Your belt's got a handle on it!? That's so cooool~!
...Could you shut these guys up for me?
What? You got some special business with me?
Hey, Turtle, how 'bout servin' up some good coffee for once!?

notes.note: God Gundam answering Black RX's 'this could be our breakthrough' (talk_003 #0.713); 'it' = that hope.
Monster names quoted in source; quotes kept.
Regis g=n -> 'its'.
System text when the facility NPC is absent; matches talk_001 Casino/Command #0.1.
Seravee (Tieria) uses boku here; calm, analytical tone kept. Subject of 'showed me' (the base's people) restored as 'they'.
#0.33/#0.34 have no Talk*.bla script in the Hangar pack (unused lines). Speaker unknown; neutral English. Probably written for the Hangar NPC (Seravee) or Zoffy.
Same Japanese as talk_001 Command #0.209 (Hikari); same English reused.
Seravee per script, though the line (rescue the Ultra Brothers) reads like a commander's; kept as mapped.
Last Hangar row; the sentence trails off in the source (impressed/reassured that Zoffy took command). Kept unfinished. 'our commander' restores the implied owner.
Placeholder text 'dummy' (unused); rendered 'Dummy' as in system slices.
Accel: 'the precious beans are crying' kept as an image ('make good beans weep').
Mame ni (diligently) may pun on coffee beans from the earlier talk; not reproducible, rendered plainly.
Urataros replying to an implied remark that he is slacking.
DenLiner (Den-O's time train) not in glossary; official English spelling used.
Kintaros (Kansai ya). Quoted 'strength' kept in quotes.
Kintaros catchphrase nakeru de -> 'make ya cry' (glossary 'You'll cry!').
Momotaros finisher per glossary 'My Special Attack, Part 2'.
Dai-senpai (Black RX as a senior Rider) rendered 'way, way senior to us'; glossary 'Sempai' is only for Momotaros.
Riff on Momotaros's 'I'm at my climax right from the start'.
Kuma-kou (Momotaros's nickname for Kintaros) rendered 'Bear', parallel to the established 'Turtle' for Kame-kou.
Urataros to Momotaros ('Sempai'); 'Kin-chan' kept romanized as in story slices.
Accel; {8074} = party leader name, padding dropped. Accel's sentence runs across #0.76/#0.78/#0.80/#0.82, interrupted by Kintaros and Ryutaros; split at the same points.
Accel Driver's throttle handle; omoshiroi in a child's delight rendered 'so cooool~'.

report: 80/80. Speakers from talkspk.py (Command: Zoffy/God Gundam; Hangar: Seravee, 00 at #0.66; Quest: Den-O Imagin, Accel, W (Philip)). Quest slice labels were wrong. Hangar #0.33/#0.34 have no script (unused), speaker unknown. Not in glossary: DenLiner (official spelling), 'Bear' for Kuma-kou.
